derived_from: TF-IDF+KMeans clustering of cleaned customer messages, see scripts/discover_intents.py output, hand-named by a human reviewer
note: Built here against the MOCK sample to prove the pipeline end-to-end. Re-run scripts/discover_intents.py against the real Kaggle data for the real brand and re-derive/rename these before treating them as final.

intents.description: Customer cannot access their account (password reset failing, locked out).
in_scope_examples: I can't log into my account, it keeps saying invalid password.
out_of_scope_examples: I want to cancel my subscription.
intents.labeling_rules: Label login_problem only if the core blocker is authentication/access, not billing or app crashes.

intents.description: Incorrect or unexpected charge (duplicate charge, wrong plan price, surprise renewal).
in_scope_examples: Charged me twice for the same order, need this fixed.
out_of_scope_examples: Requested a refund on order X a week ago, still nothing.
intents.labeling_rules: If the customer is disputing a charge that already happened -> billing_issue. If they already agree a refund is owed and are asking about its status -> refund_request.

intents.description: Customer is explicitly asking for, or following up on, a refund.
in_scope_examples: Can I get a refund for order X, item arrived damaged.
out_of_scope_examples: Why was I billed $58.99 when my plan is $22.99?
intents.labeling_rules: Requires the word 'refund' or a clear ask for money back, not just a billing dispute.

intents.description: Order not received, stuck in transit, or tracking not updating.
in_scope_examples: Order says delivered but I never received it.
Package in transit for 9 days, tracking not updating.
out_of_scope_examples: Item arrived damaged, want a refund.
intents.labeling_rules: Physical delivery/logistics issue only; damaged-item-plus-refund-ask goes to refund_request.

intents.description: App or website malfunction (crash, error page, broken feature).
in_scope_examples: App crashes every time I open the payments tab.
Checkout throwing a 500 error on step 3.
out_of_scope_examples: Can't log in because of invalid password.
intents.labeling_rules: Login/auth failures are login_problem even though technically an app behavior; everything else app/site-broken is technical_problem.

intents.description: Customer wants to cancel a subscription/service.
in_scope_examples: How do I cancel my subscription? Can't find the option.
out_of_scope_examples: Auto-renewed without warning, want a refund.
intents.labeling_rules: Pure cancel-the-service asks only; renewal disputes are billing_issue.

intents.description: General dissatisfaction, often about repeated unresolved contact, not tied to one specific transactional ask.
in_scope_examples: Extremely disappointed with support response time, this is the 3rd time I've written in.
intents.labeling_rules: Use complaint only when there is no clear single actionable request - otherwise prefer the more specific intent.
